# A failed write is logged with the package ID and the OS error, the run exits
# non-zero, and the original file is left as it was.

[root] skip 'permission checks do not apply to root'

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
chmod 0555 .
! loopvec -split .
chmod 0755 .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig
! exists ops_simd.go

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
loopvec: example.com/test: open $WORK/ops_simd.go: permission denied
loopvec: errors occurred
